full_judgment:
This Rule is directed against the judgment and decree dated 28-8-2005 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Naogaon in Title Appeals No. 315 of 2004 allowing the appeal, dismissing the suit on setting aside those dated 10-10-2004 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, 3rd Court, Naogaon in Other Class Suit No. 155 of 2003 decreeing the suit. 

 5. The learned Assistant Judge, 3rd Court, Naogaon by the judgment and decree dated 10-10-2004 decreed the suit in part declaring the decision of the Managing Committed dated 29-9-2003 to be illegal. 

 6. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and decree defendant preferred Title Appeal No. 315 of 2004 and that appeal was heard by the learned Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Naogaon who by the impugned judgment and decree dated 28-8-2005 allowed the appeal, dismissed the suit holding that the suit was not maintainable without submitting any reply as against show cause called for from the plaintiff. 

 7. Being aggrieved by the said Judgment and decree the plaintiff has obtained the Rule. 

 8. Mr Ozair Faruque with Mr Sk Md Morshed, the learned Advocate, on appearing for the petitioner, took me to the impugned judgment and decree and as well as to the judgment of the trial Court and formulated the following branches of arguments: 

 29. In the result, the Rule is discharged however, without any order as to cost. The impugned judgment and decree dated 28-8-2005 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Naogaon in Title Appeal No. 315 of 2004 allowing the appeal, dismissing the suit on setting aside those dated 10-10-2004 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, 3rd Court, Naogaon in Other Class Suit No. 155 of 2003 is hereby affirmed. The order of status quo granted by this Court dated 5-9-2005 is hereby vacated.
